advisories.title: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in com.google.code.gson:gson
advisories.description: Affected versions of com.google.code.gson:gson are vulnerable to Deserialization of Untrusted Data. Before version 2.8.9, deserializing untrusted data using Java's default serialization (e.g. `(String) obj.readObject()`) into one of the internal Gson classes `LazilyParsedNumber`, `LinkedTreeMap` or `LinkedHashTreeMap` can result in a denial of service. These classes are meant to be serialized and deserialized through Gson's own methods and not through Java's default serialization. Note that deserializing untrusted data using any method is risky without strict restrictions on the classes allowed to be deserialized.

owaspIds: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
A08:2025 - Software or Data Integrity Failures
